text:
mira: deploy-bot flagged a mismatch during the EU midnight window. Release notes for 9.3.0 mention a config schema change (`max_connections_per_worker`) but the binary rejects unknown schema keys.

deploy-bot: Safety check RN-333 fired: release_notes_schema_mismatch. Suggested actions: pause rollout, rollback to 9.2.7, or ship hotpatch that tolerates unknown keys.

ops-raj: Any customer impact?

mira: No external alerts yet. QA saw a canary fail with: `UnhandledSchemaError: unknown key 'max_connections_per_worker'` during config load.

sam: Hotpatch (9.3.1) could add schema leniency and a migration warning; rollback is faster but splits metrics. EU Dedicated pools may have started pulling the image.

legal-ivy: If Dedicated customers rely on the new schema, undocumented behavior could be risky. Recommend rollback for EU pools and block further Dedicated promotion until fixed.

support-lee: I'll draft an internal CSM note: "Paused EU rollout for schema mismatch; no customer-facing errors observed; rollback in progress for EU."

ops-raj: Plan: pause the staged rollout globally, but perform targeted rollback in EU region back to 9.2.7 to avoid Dedicated drift. Commands: `deployctl pause --release 9.3.0` then `deployctl traffic pin --region eu-west-1 --to 9.2.7 --percent 100`. ETA ~12m for region rollback.

ops-raj: Running now: `deployctl pause --release 9.3.0` -> paused. `deployctl traffic pin --region eu-west-1 --to 9.2.7 --percent 100` -> applied.

deploy-bot: Region rollback job started. Notifying on-call.

mira: I'll prepare a hotpatch branch that adds schema backward-compat parsing and a feature flag. We'll cut 9.3.1 for a coordinated EU+Dedic rollout after tests.

sam: Staging smoke for 9.3.1 should include config load with deprecated keys and Dedicated registry pull simulation.

ops-raj: Rollback completed for eu-west-1. Health checks green. Hosted rollouts remain paused.

support-lee: Internal note posted to #support-ops and CSMs alerted.

legal-ivy: Keeping audit record. Please include changelog footnote linking to this rollback.

mira: Filing follow-ups: RN-334 (changelog gate for schema changes), RN-335 (CI test for config parsing), RN-336 (ops runbook update for region-scoped rollbacks).

deploy-bot: Rollback complete for region eu-west-1. Global rollout remains paused pending RN-334..RN-336.

mira: Closing thread after hotpatch passes staging. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
